### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | SAGE-wide policy (applies to OMEGA as a SAGE journal; no OMEGA-specific AI policy page found). AI/LLM tools cannot be listed as an author. Assistive AI (grammar/language polishing) needs no disclosure. Generative AI used for content creation must be disclosed (methods or acknowledgements) at submission. Generating primary manuscript text or fabricating content/citations via prompt chains is prohibited; editors can reject at any time if inappropriate GenAI use is found; authors bear responsibility for verifying all AI-assisted output. OMEGA's own submission-guidelines page reiterates 'AI chatbots should not be listed as authors' and points back to this general Sage GenAI policy (per search-engine cache of https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/ome; page itself could not be fetched live, so treat that specific attribution as secondary/derived). |
| **Source URL** | https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy |
